description: Header file defining the DictionaryManager class for managing language dictionaries in the tinygettext library, including methods for setting language, managing search paths, and handling dictionary data.

classes.name: tinygettext::DictionaryManager
classes.description: Manages language dictionaries, loads .po files based on language settings, and handles search paths and character sets.

methods.name: get_dictionary
methods.description: Returns the currently active dictionary, or an empty dictionary if none is set.

methods.name: get_dictionary (overload)
methods.description: Returns the dictionary for a specified language.

methods.name: set_language
methods.description: Sets the current language based on a language object.

methods.name: get_language
methods.description: Returns the normalized country code of the current language.

methods.name: get_use_fuzzy
methods.description: Returns whether fuzzy matching is enabled.

methods.name: set_charset
methods.description: Sets the character set for dictionaries.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Adds a directory to the search path for dictionaries, with optional precedence.

methods.name: remove_directory
methods.description: Removes a directory from the search path.

methods.name: get_languages
methods.description: Returns a set of available languages in their country codes.

methods.name: set_filesystem
methods.description: Sets the filesystem object used by the manager.

methods.name: convertFilename2Language
methods.description: Converts a filename to a language code.
